description: NNPC Limited's news, from the CMS API that its website's own pages call.
finding: https://nnpcgroup.com/insights is a Nuxt page whose list is filled in by the browser from https://fde-nnpc-web-cms-prod-dwfrd0hraahrbhhg.a02.azurefd.net/api/posts (Strapi JSON: data[] with id, title, content as HTML, post_date, slug, publishedAt, post_category; meta.pagination). The default order is oldest first; sort=publishedAt:desc gives the newest. Individual pages (https://nnpcgroup.com/insights/<slug>) are server-rendered. The 10 newest posts (29 Aug to 29 Sep 2026 and the July monthly report) are press releases and corporate reports; none announces a petrol, diesel or gas price, so this source may add little to the price questions.
robots_txt: nnpcgroup.com: allows everything (Disallow empty). The API host has not been checked.
terms_note: General terms (https://nnpcgroup.com/terms-of-use): content may be printed for personal, non-commercial use; copying, republishing or distributing it is not allowed except as the terms permit. Stores and quotes beyond that need permission. The seeded permission (link and 300-character quotation) stays within a quotation reading but should be reviewed.
trimmed: Each post's content (HTML) is cut to 300 characters; everything else is as served. original_sha256 is of the untrimmed response.
